title: Reunion at the Secret Realm's Entrance
next_chapter_hook: Dark radiance swirled in Ye Qing's hands, as if brewing some terrifying technique, while a meaningful curve formed at the corner of Chen Ji's lips—the frontal confrontation within this secret realm seemed destined from the start to claim its price from someone.

text.content: At the end of the dim corridor, an ancient bronze door stood silently, its surface covered with mottled ancient inscriptions, emanating a faint sense of vicissitude. Chen Ji's footsteps halted, his right hand instinctively pressing against his chest—where the Tianji Record Fragment was trembling at a near-burning frequency, as if warning him of the danger ahead.

dialogue.content: 「Lad, the barrier of the second layer is more than ten times stronger than the first. Those demonic cultivators wouldn't dare set an ambush here without relying on something.」The voice of the Residual Soul Guardian rang in his Mental Sea, tinged with gravity. 「With your current cultivation level, a direct assault is absolutely not the wise choice.」

text.content: Chen Ji offered no response, merely extending his spiritual sense cautiously. From the gaps of the ancient bronze door,诡异的紫黑色光芒透出，夹杂着淡淡的血腥气息。He眸光微闪，心中已有了计较——魔道修士的气息，他再熟悉不过，毕竟那位魔道圣女身上，就常年萦绕着这股令人作呕的甜腻香味。

dialogue.content: 「Since you've come, hiding isn't a solution.」Chen Ji murmured to himself, a playful smile forming at the corner of his mouth. He deliberately suppressed his cultivation to Foundation Building early stage, staggering toward the bronze door with a panicked, useless appearance. 「Ah, wh-where is this place...」

text.content: The moment the door opened, a fierce sword qi pierced through the air! Chen Ji dodged the lethal strike by a hair's breadth, tumbling clumsily to the ground. Looking up, he saw more than a dozen black figures rushing from all directions, surrounding him completely. And at the very center of the crowd, a graceful yet dangerous figure looked down at him from above, her eyes filled with playful contempt.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing wore a purple-black gown, demonic energy swirling around her like a beautiful demon emerging from an abyss. In her hand she held a slender, jet-black flexible sword, its blade flowing with eerie patterns. Now a mocking smile curled at her lips: 「Useless trash is useless trash, even falling while walking.」

text.content: Chen Ji rose from the ground, brushing the dust from his clothes, his face full of panic and confusion: 「Y-Ye Holy Maiden? W-What is the meaning of this? This insignificant one has no grudge with the Holy Sect, nor any recent enmity...」His voice trembled slightly, but his gaze inadvertently swept across his surroundings, memorizing the position and cultivation level of each demonic cultivator.

dialogue.content: 「Stop your theatrical pretense.」Ye Qing coldly laughed, her flexible sword trembling lightly, emitting a crisp chime. 「The useless servant from Tianqing Sect, sneaking into the second layer of the secret realm alone and still claiming innocence? Do you take this Holy Maiden for a three-year-old?」She stepped forward, examining Chen Ji from above. 「Speak—exactly what are you scheming?」

choice.prompt: Facing the demonic Holy Maiden's interrogation, how should Chen Ji respond to this dangerous confrontation?

choices.description: Reveal your hand directly, respond to Ye Qing's threats with a dominant posture, display your true strength to intimidate everyone present. Extremely high risk, but may disrupt enemy arrangements.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing cultivation may attract other factions' covetous attention
choices.visible_reward: Completely control the situation, making Ye Qing look at one with new eyes
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's strength is profound, outcome of frontal clash is unpredictable
choices.process_label: 陈机眼神骤变，周身气势陡然攀升

text.content: The panic on Chen Ji's face vanished instantly, replaced by a kind of worldly indifference. He slowly straightened his posture, the previously cowardly and lowly aura swept away, replaced by a chilling edge that made hearts race.

flags_set: 夜清已知陈机真实实力

choices.description: Continue playing the role of a废物, lower Ye Qing's vigilance with a humble demeanor, seek opportunities to escape or secretly lay plans. Lower risk, but may be continuously humiliated.
choices.visible_cost: Lose all face, may be publicly humiliated
choices.visible_reward: Maintain disguise advantage, obtain crucial intelligence
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing is extremely suspicious, any flaw in acting will lead to exposure
choices.process_label: 陈机继续瑟瑟发抖，表现得更加不堪

dialogue.content: 「Spare this one, Holy Maiden! This insignificant one truly wandered here by accident, absolutely no ulterior motives!」Chen Ji's knees buckled, directly kneeling to the ground, his voice trembling so much it nearly carried sobs, yet in an angle no one noticed, he subtly gestured to Ye Qing.

flags_set: 陈机夜清秘密手势暗号已触发

choices.description: Using benefit exchange as the entry point, proactively propose possible cooperation, use mutual enemies as bargaining chips. Display eloquence and wisdom, strive for initiative at the negotiating table.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing some trump cards may allow Ye Qing to discern intentions
choices.visible_reward: May establish a temporary alliance to jointly deal with the secret realm's true threats
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing is extremely scheming, any misstep in negotiation may fall into a trap
choices.process_label: 陈机眼中精光一闪，语气变得从容不迫

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly stood up, brushing the dust from his knees, his gaze becoming deep and calm: 「Ye Holy Maiden, although the secret realm's supreme treasure is tempting, compared to that mutual enemy behind us, it seems not that important anymore, doesn't it?」

flags_set: 陈机主动提及圣宗阴谋

text.content: Ye Qing's pupils slightly contracted, her flexible sword trembling lightly. She clearly hadn't expected this废物 to be so composed under her imposing suppression. What intrigued her more was that gesture only the two of them would understand—that rescue signal Chen Ji had taught her during their last secret meeting.

dialogue.content: 「Interesting.」Ye Qing's smile deepened, yet her vigilance did not relax. She raised her hand to halt her restless subordinates, slowly walking toward Chen Ji, her voice low and dangerous. 「This Holy Maiden would like to hear exactly who your so-called 'mutual enemy' refers to?」

text.content: Chen Ji stared directly into Ye Qing's eyes, speaking word by word: 「The Holy Sect. Or rather—that force controlling Holy Maiden.」The words fell, surrounding demonic cultivators immediately erupted in commotion, some even drawing weapons. Ye Qing's expression slightly changed, demonic energy around her suddenly surging, a terrifying pressure sweeping toward Chen Ji.

dialogue.content: 「You know quite a lot.」Ye Qing's voice came from the Nine Abyssal Depths, ice-cold and piercing. Her wrist flipped, the flexible sword transforming into a black light thrusting directly toward Chen Ji's throat, its speed almost impossible to dodge. 「Then you must be eliminated even more!」

text.content: When the sword tip was less than three cun from Chen Ji's throat, his figure suddenly blurred, dodging this fatal strike from an unbelievable angle. Meanwhile, his right hand extended, two fingers precisely clamping the flexible sword's blade, no matter how Ye Qing urged her True Qi, it could not advance even a fraction.

dialogue.content: 「This...」Ye Qing's pupils dilated sharply, shock appearing on her face for the first time. Her full-power strike was so easily received by this废物 at Foundation Building early stage? 「You... have been hiding your strength all along!」

choice.prompt: Chen Ji successfully displayed his strength, Ye Qing is in shock—how should he proceed?

choices.description: Seize the moment of enemy shock, completely shatter their psychological defenses with words, creating a classic scene of pretending to be a pig to devour the tiger.
choices.visible_cost: Completely enrage Ye Qing, may provoke a siege by demonic cultivators
choices.visible_reward: Everyone present is shocked, Ye Qing loses all face
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's strength is considerable, pushed too far may result in mutual destruction
choices.process_label: 陈机松开手指，似笑非笑地看着夜清

dialogue.content: 「Holy Maiden's previous sword strike used seven-tenths of strength, seemingly leaving three-tenths in reserve to guard against others.」Chen Ji released his fingers, gently blowing his fingertips, looking at Ye Qing with a half-smile. 「Are you afraid of hurting someone you shouldn't, or... afraid of exposing something?」

choices.description: Proactively step back to show goodwill, indicate no ill intentions, strive for negotiating room. Display magnanimity and bearing.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the best opportunity to intimidate the enemy
choices.visible_reward: May establish mutual trust, paving the way for future cooperation
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing is suspicious, may think this is a delaying tactic
choices.process_label: 陈机松开软剑，后退两步拱手作揖

dialogue.content: Chen Ji laughed lightly, released his fingers, stepped back two paces, and clasped his hands in salute: 「May Holy Maiden not be impatient. Chen has no ill intentions. The previous was merely self-defense. Please listen to my words before making any decisions.」

choices.description: Directly point out the truth of Ye Qing being controlled by the Holy Sect, force her to face her situation, persuade her toward cooperation through interests.
choices.visible_cost: May completely enrage Ye Qing, immediate fallout
choices.visible_reward: If successful, will completely break the deadlock, establish deep alliance
choices.risk_hint: Touching Ye Qing's sore spot, extremely risky
choices.process_label: 陈机目光如炬，直刺夜清双眼

dialogue.content: 「Holy Maiden, that restriction on your body, it flares up every full moon night, causing unbearable agony, doesn't it?」Chen Ji's voice was not loud, yet like a thunderclap exploding beside Ye Qing's ear. 「The Holy Sect's 'grace' to you—you know it well yourself.」

flags_set: 夜清身怀禁制之秘被点破

text.content: Ye Qing froze in place, her expression a kaleidoscope of emotions—shock, anger, fear, shame... various feelings intertwined, finally transforming into a bitter cold laugh. She took a deep breath, waved her hand to dismiss her subordinates: 「All withdraw. Without this Holy Maiden's order, no one is to approach.」

dialogue.content: After the demonic cultivators withdrew more than ten zhang, Ye Qing finally spoke, her voice hoarse: 「Chen Ji, exactly who are you? Why do you know my affairs so clearly?」She stared into Chen Ji's eyes, as if trying to see through him. 「The useless servant from Tianqing Sect could never possess such ability.」

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, in the dim secret realm passage his figure appearing mysterious and profound. After a moment, he took out a yellowed fragment from his bosom, gently waving it before Ye Qing. On the Tianji Record Fragment, faint mysterious runes could be seen slowly flowing, emanating an ancient aura that made hearts palpitate.

dialogue.content: 「This is...」Ye Qing's pupils dilated sharply, an inexplicable fear and reverence welling up simultaneously. As a demonic Holy Maiden, she was not unfamiliar with ancient forbidden artifacts, yet the power contained within this fragment before her far exceeded her imagination. 「Tianji Record? You actually possess such a forbidden object!」

text.content: 「Holy Maiden is indeed knowledgeable.」Chen Ji put away the fragment, speaking calmly. 「This fragment allows me to glimpse three hours of heavenly secrets in the future, at the cost of consuming precious Heavenly Fate. It is precisely by relying on it that I can understand Holy Maiden's situation so thoroughly.」He paused, his gaze profound. 「Likewise, I also know what kind of secret this secret realm truly conceals.」

Ye Qing was silent for a long while, finally sighing deeply: 「Speak then, what do you want?」Her tone no longer carried the previous contempt and hostility, replaced by exhaustion and helplessness. 「Since you know even about the restriction on my body, you must also understand that I am merely a chess piece being manipulated.」

Chen Ji looked at this demonic Holy Maiden whose exterior was cold and powerful yet whose fate was beyond her control, a sentiment of sympathy arising in his heart. Though their positions differed, both were pitiful people caught in fate's grip. Footsteps from the secret realm's depths grew ever closer, the time remaining for them was already scarce.

「Cooperation.」Chen Ji stared directly into Ye Qing's eyes, his tone firm and unquestionable. 「The secret realm's supreme treasure we each take what we need, but before that, first join hands to eliminate those uninvited 'guests'—personnel from the three major sects have already slipped in, and behind us, an even more dangerous existence approaches.」No sooner had the words fallen than descending clamor of footsteps indeed echoed from the passage's depths, accompanied by several powerful surges of spiritual energy.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's gaze turned sharp, her ear pricked—sure enough, she detected distant unusual movements. Her gaze toward Chen Ji carried a more complex expression: 「You calculated even this?」She gritted her teeth, finally nodding. 「Fine, temporary cooperation once. But the matter of the secret realm's supreme treasure—we each rely on our own ability!」

text.content: 「Each relies on their own ability.」A slight smile formed at Chen Ji's mouth as he turned, walking toward the passage's depths. His back in the gloom appeared lonely yet resolute, as if accustomed to facing all unknown dangers alone. Ye Qing gazing at that back, an odd feeling suddenly surged in her heart—perhaps this man's true face was even more unfathomable than she had imagined.

Yet just then, Chen Ji's footsteps suddenly halted. He turned back to look at Ye Qing, a rare seriousness flickering in his eyes: 「One more thing—Ling Yuan, that old sect master of Tianqing Sect, he has entered the secret realm.」Ye Qing's pupils slightly contracted, clearly having heard this name before. Chen Ji continued, 「This person is the real trouble. If encountered in the secret realm, Holy Maiden had best stay far away from him.」

dialogue.content: 「Ling Yuan?」Ye Qing frowned slightly. 「I have heard that several decades ago this person entered closed-door seclusion to impact the Transformation God stage, never expecting him to still be alive...」She looked at Chen Ji, her gaze carrying a hint of inquiry. 「You seem especially wary of him.」

text.content: Chen Ji offered no answer, merely casting Ye Qing a meaningful glance. That gaze seemed to hold ten thousand words, yet also seemed to hold nothing at all. After a moment, he turned and continued forward, his voice drifting back悠悠: 「Some things, knowing too much is not good. Holy Maiden only needs to remember—in this secret realm, trust no one except me.」

In the dim passage, two figures walked one after another toward the unknown depths. Behind them were restlessly stirring demonic cultivators, in the distance were approaching strong ones from the three major sects, and farther still, that man 'selected' by the Tianji Record, silently observing all this from somewhere. Chen Ji touched the fragment at his chest, his heart silently reciting—Tianji Record, exactly how many secrets are you still hiding?
